title: "Why do you lock your door?" - RVASec 2012
summary: Locksport historian Schuyler Towne's RVASec 2012 talk on why people lock their doors, tracing the history of locks and the assumptions about security behind them.
why: HN commenters call it a passionate and educational history of locks and physical security, and a good starting point for the subject.
topic: history of locks and physical security

quote.text: It's a great place to start.
